# MindSpark — Design Notes

## Source
- ColorLib: Knowledge (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/knowledge/)
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/knowledge/

## Section order
1. Navbar (logo, nav links, "Get started" button)
2. Hero Slider (3 slides, Flexslider, centered text)
3. Categories (6 items: Web Dev, Mobile Dev, Science Data, etc.)
4. Popular Courses (5 course cards)
5. About (text + images)
6. Counters (4 stats)
7. Trainers (circular avatars)
8. Events (4 entries with dates)
9. Blog (3 posts, light gray bg)
10. Footer (dark, columns, Component Dock)

## Tokens
- Primary: #4586ff (blue) | Dark: #000 / #252525 / #302a39
- Accent: #F7AF1D (gold) | Font: Rubik
- Buttons: 30px radius | Avatars: 50%
